title: Ecology and the Language of Measurement
text:
Ecologists use a precise vocabulary to describe populations. A 'biomass' figure records the total mass of living organisms in an area, whereas 'biodiversity' refers to the variety of species present. Confusing the two can lead to misleading claims about the health of an ecosystem.

The term 'carrying capacity' illustrates the same problem in reverse. It denotes the largest population an environment can sustain indefinitely, not the number of animals that happen to live there today. Careful definitions therefore protect researchers from drawing conclusions the data cannot support.

questions.text: According to the passage, what does 'biomass' record?
options: The variety of species present in an area
The total mass of living organisms in an area
The rate at which species die out
The number of animals living there today
The largest population an environment can sustain indefinitely
The weight a predator can carry
The maximum rainfall of a region

questions.text: Why are careful definitions important, according to the passage?
options: They prevent researchers from drawing conclusions the data cannot support
They allow researchers to avoid measurement
They ensure all species are counted equally

questions.text: What is the author's point in describing 'carrying capacity' as the problem 'in reverse'?
options: The term is less important than biomass
Like biodiversity and biomass, it is easily confused with a different measure: the present population
It is a term used only in economics
It describes predators rather than prey

vocabulary.definition: the total mass of living organisms in a given area
the variety of species present in an environment
a community of living organisms interacting with their environment
to keep something going over a long period

paragraph_translations: ሥነ-ምኅዳር ተመራማሪዎች ሕዝቦችን ለመግለጽ ትክክለኛ ቃላትን ይጠቀማሉ። 'ባዮማስ' በአካባቢ ያለውን የሕያዋን ፍጥረታት አጠቃላይ ክብደት ይመዘግባል፤ 'የብዝሃ ሕይወት' ደግሞ በዚያ ያሉትን የዝርያዎች ልዩነት ያመለክታል። ሁለቱን መለየት ስለ ሥነ-ምኅዳር ጤና የሚያሳስቱ መግለጫዎችን ሊያስከትል ይችላል።
'የመሸከም አቅም' የሚለው ቃል ተመሳሳይ ችግርን በተቃራኒ መንገድ ያሳያል። ይህ ቃል አካባቢው ለዘላቂነት ሊደግፈው የሚችለውን ከፍተኛ ሕዝብ ያመለክታል፤ ዛሬ የሚኖሩትን እንስሳት ቁጥር አይደለም። ስለዚህ ጥንቃቄ የተሞላባቸው ትርጓሜዎች ተመራማሪዎችን መረጃው ሊደግፈው ከማይችል መደምደሚያ ይጠብቃሉ።
